turns.text:
ok bestie i need a funny flyer or meme thing for work lol
im at taqueria colima, i take orders at the counter. yesterday was the friday dinner rush and the line was backed up out the door becuase our grill cook wont stop doing bits

Ha, love this. A rush-hour parody flyer is a great idea. Quick things so I can aim the joke: what's the grill cook's name, and what kind of jokes does he do? Anything you want in the picture, like menu items or the counter?

his name is héctor. hes kind of a show off ngl, does the whole loud joke thing at the grill and then the tickets just pile up 💀
put the free quesadilla plate in there too, thats my shift meal lol. tease him a little but nothing mean

Got it, gentle roast only. Here's what I made:

[Image: A retro "WANTED"-style flyer on cream paper with red and green taco-stand trim. Headline: "WANTED: ORDERS MOVING." In the center is a cartoon grill cook in a tall chef hat, mid-bit with a spatula as a microphone and a tiny spotlight on him, while a long line of cartoon customers with hungry thought bubbles stretches out the door behind him. A row of paper tickets hangs above the grill, droopier and longer on each side. At the bottom corner, a cartoon cashier sits at the counter with a plate holding one golden quesadilla, labeled "Cashier's Shift Meal (Protected Asset)." Fine print: "Last seen: doing a bit. Tickets: still waiting." Footer: "Taquería Colima - Friday Dinner Rush Edition."]

Caption option: "Héctor: *tells joke* / The line: *ages in real time*"

Want a spicier version, or one that's even softer?

omg the protected asset part 😭😭 perfect
ok but this stays between us pls. i usually make little edit videos and never post them, its just for me. dont wanna make it weird at work lol anyway

Totally, this stays as a private joke. It's just here in our chat, and you can keep it as a no-post file. If you ever want to turn it into one of your edit videos for yourself, I can help with a caption, a sound-sync idea, or a quick text overlay. Want a smaller version sized for a phone wallpaper?
